pages.text: Each tier unlocks by completing $(bold)any 1 of 5 quest paths$() in FTB Quests: Grinding, Magic, Combat, Exploration, or Engineering.$(br2)$(bold)Why 5 paths?$() Multiple playstyles supported equally. Extra paths give bonus skill points and loot boxes but are never required.$(br2)$(bold)Backup Path:$() KubeJS milestone detection auto-grants tier access from key events (boss kills, dimension entries). Grants tier access only - no skill points or loot boxes.$(br2)$(bold)Tier Tokens:$() Consumed in crafting, not required for advancement. Full tokens from bosses/quests; fragments (5 = 1 token) from chests.
